notes:
FAX (also written as ファックス or ⟦ファクス→ファクス：13636_fakusu⟧) is short for facsimile. Despite being considered outdated technology in many countries, fax remains surprisingly common in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- FAX⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ (to send a fax)
- FAX⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧ (to receive a fax)
- FAX{番号|ばんごう} (fax number)
- FAX⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (fax machine)

FAX IN JAPAN:
Japan continues to use fax extensively due to:
- ⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧ (seal) culture requiring physical documents
- {個人情報保護|こじんじょうほうほご} concerns with email
- Traditional business practices in older companies
- Government offices often requiring fax submissions

MODERN USAGE:
- ⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧FAX (internet fax services)
- FAX⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧ (fax apps)
- ⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧FAX (convenience store fax service)

DECLINING USAGE:
COVID-19 highlighted issues with fax dependency, and there's increasing push for ⟦{デジタル化|でじたるか}→デジタル化：08829_dejitaruka⟧ in Japan.

REGISTER: Neutral. Still standard in business contexts.
